paired_quality_comparison.unit: task, after averaging the two independent candidate generations
paired_quality_comparison.bootstrap_note: Percentile interval from paired task resampling; it omits systematic judge and provider uncertainty.

supplemental_scoring_policies.selection_rule: Eligibility uses failure types and exact error messages only. Scores do not influence retry or selection. The frozen runner reuses the first completed schema-valid assessment.

main_quality_unit: Each task mean of two independent answers; 60 tasks per condition
timing_unit: Each successful candidate turn; 120 answers per condition
limitations: Subjective judge with strong score ceiling
Same model family judge may favor Sol
Dates and provider routes are not controlled
Upstream actual model and reasoning budget are not independently verifiable
TTFT and TPOT are missing; visible text wait is a separate metric
Bootstrap intervals omit systematic judge and provider uncertainty
